# 11 Senate Races to Watch

In the wake of the 2024 elections, the conventional wisdom was that the Senate
would be out of reach for Democrats come the midterms two years later. That's
completely changed, and the Senate could actually flip.

Republicans currently hold a **53-47 majority** in the Senate. Democrats must
**net four seats** to take control of the Senate and overcome a tiebreaker
vote from Vice President JD Vance. (That's assuming Democrats' pro-Israel
fanatic Senator John Fetterman doesn't leave the party… so they might even
need to win five!)
